net.buffer_guide.title: How do I connect my Buffer account?
net.buffer_guide.intro: Complete these steps from your own Buffer session.
net.buffer_guide.step1: In Buffer, first connect the LinkedIn, Instagram, or Facebook account you want to use.
net.buffer_guide.step2: Open Settings → API → Personal Access, create a new key with account read and posting permissions, then copy it.
net.buffer_guide.step3: Get the relevant channel ID from your Buffer channels list, complete the three fields below, then select Test and save.
net.buffer_guide.security: The key is personal: do not send it by email. It will be tested, encrypted, and never displayed again.
